column5: Quick Attack only strikes first, not twice: Mk5 Rocket Blaster, Legion Drummer.
Trekking Aldermen and Svalblod Fanatic grow from damage; Punish and Noxian Guillotine only punish damaged units.
Jade Monk and Statikk Shock are small fixed damage; Toxicologist and Rock Accelerator are not.
Onyx Bear Seal and Blood of Air transform an enemy; Metamorphosis is only until end of turn.
Master Mold and Rapala give junk cards; Crimson Curse and Armor Up only spawn units on board.
Dominate Will and Mercenary Manners take an enemy; Usurper cards seize their own spawned Operatives.
Ironcliffe Guardian (Airdrop) and Kraken (Disloyal) land in the enemy camp; Hellfire Club and Ikari only restrict plays.
Broken Captive (Rush) and Margarita Zeal act at once; Raven and Cintrian Artificer do not.
Sleet Dasher and Blood in the Water (Rally) act again; Greenfang Warden is just Barrier, Scout.
Crescent Strike and Hexplosive Minefield stun; Provoke cards (Fireblazer) force attacks, not lock.
Kindred and Icy Cilophyte mark/weaken a target for later hits; Ram Stance and Temple of Time do not.
Heartseeker and Oradrim Sagittarius are Ranged; Elusive and Fearsome cards (Viego) are not reach.
